blocks.text: Eukaryotes ki is kingdom mein janwar (animals) aate hain, jo eukaryotic, multicellular aur heterotrophic hain. Yeh embryo se develop hote hain. Yeh khana nigalte (ingest) hain aur apne jism ke andar digest (hazam) karte hain.

items: Protista: unicellular, colonial, filamentous ya simple multicellular eukaryotes; janwaron jaise protozoa, podon jaise algae, aur fungi jaise slime molds aur water molds.
Fungi: chitin ki cell wall; ghiza nigalte nahi, jazb karte hain; Zygomycota (septa nahi), Ascomycota aur Basidiomycota (septate hyphae).
Plantae: cellulose ki wall, photosynthetic, embryo se develop; nonvascular bryophytes aur vascular plants (seedless aur seed plants).
Animalia: multicellular, heterotrophic, embryo se develop, khana nigal kar andar digest karte hain.
Sirf Animalia mein cell wall nahi hoti; Fungi ki wall chitin ki aur Plantae ki cellulose ki hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek multicellular eukaryote apne ird gird se ghiza jazb karta hai aur us ki cell walls chitin ki hain. Yeh kis kingdom mein hai, aur sirf cell wall dekh kar kaun si doosri kingdoms khaarij ho jati hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh Fungi hai. Chitin ki wall Plantae ko khaarij karti hai, jin ki walls cellulose ki hoti hain, aur Animalia ko bhi, jin mein cell wall hoti hi nahi.
